reason: A WebUI plugin for scheduling dsh-web restarts through a sidebar button, /restart command, and local API, with systemd process control, reconnect handling, and best-effort resumption of interrupted agents.

summaries.zh: 通过侧栏按钮、/restart 命令和本地 API 调度 dsh-web 重启，并在服务恢复后自动重连和尝试续接中断的智能体会话。
summaries.en: Schedules dsh-web restarts through a sidebar button, the /restart command, or a local API, then reconnects the browser and attempts to resume interrupted agent sessions.

capabilities: Adds a WebUI restart button and /restart command
Exposes a local restart API endpoint
Schedules systemd user-service restart via process spawning
Writes and consumes restart and resume state files
Attempts to resume interrupted agent sessions after restart
Automatically reconnects the browser after service restart
